title: My Nephew Stole My $750K Map Collection And Gave Me $4K. So I Made Him Dust The Globes.
description: After I cashed out my $122K 401(k) to restore rare antique maps with my nephew, he forged a dissolution and sold our collection for $750K, mailing me a $4,000 compass check. I found the original partnership papers hidden inside a hollow globe my sister gave me, voided the sale, and now he dusts the globes wearing a shirt that reads 'Off the Map of Trust' while every reproduction map includes a QR code to his fraud conviction. #familybetrayal #karma #truejustice
thumb_text: HE FORGED THE SALE, NOW HE DUSTS MY GLOBES
pinned_comment: If your nephew forged your name, sold your $750,000 map collection and sent you a $4,000 check, what would you have done? Share your own family betrayal stories below, I'm reading every single one.
